title: Halo Dental news list
description: Press list on cream: a 64px heading with an outline button, then rows ruled with 1px black lines, each holding a 16:9 thumbnail, a 28px headline, a short summary and a small white arrow tile, all snapped to a 12-column grid. The last row fades out under a centred outline button.
notes: pass photos or publication logos through items[].media; the empty tile is white (card)
leave out `more` to show every row at full strength
name: halodental-opus-news

props.name: link
props.description: the outline button beside (desktop) or under (phones) the heading

props.name: items
props.description: the stories, one ruled row each

props.name: more
props.description: the outline button centred under the list; the last row fades out above it
